scope_note: This inventory measures linked evidence coverage only, not truth/falsity of any qualitative assessment or availability of sources elsewhere.

promotion_contract.performance: Named workload, source implementation and inputs/digest, language and compiler/runtime exact version, build flags, operating system, CPU/platform and test resources, warmup/calibration, repetition and raw samples, robust summary, reproducibility reference and appropriate comparison baseline required before specific band may become Reviewed.
promotion_contract.complexity: Explicit user/team profile, task definition, scope and scoring anchors, evaluator protocol, sample/results, version/toolchain/platform and repeatable adjudication with evidence refs required before specific band may become Reviewed.
promotion_contract.status: UNKNOWN until band-specific independently checkable records are accepted in a later dataset version.
